'''Iron ore''' can be mined from [[iron rocks]] at level 15 [[Mining]], providing 35 Mining [[experience]]. It can be smelted at a [[furnace]] into an [[iron bar]] at level 15 [[Smithing]], or along with two [[coal]] into a [[steel bar]] at level 30 Smithing. Smelting iron bars has a 50% success rate, unless the player is wearing a [[ring of forging]], using the [[Superheat Item]] spell, or using the [[Blast Furnace]]. Smelting iron ore into a bar gives 12.5 Smithing experience, and smelting a steel bar gives 17.5 Smithing experience.

'''Iron rocks''' are a type of protruding rock that contains [[iron ore]]. Players with a [[Mining]] level of 15 or higher can mine iron ore from rocks found in various [[List of mines|mines]], granting 35 Mining [[experience]] for each ore mined. After being mined, an iron rock takes 5.4 seconds to [[respawn]]. When inside the [[members]]' area of the [[Mining Guild]], that time is reduced to 2.4 seconds; the faster respawn time makes it the best place to [[Pay-to-play Mining training#Fastest experience|power-mine]] iron, with an experience rate of up to 70k xp/h. 

Iron is the most popular ore that [[free-to-play]] players power-mine for experience. For locations where there are three rocks in a triangle formation suitable for proper power-mining, see [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|here]].

Wearing [[mining gloves]], [[superior mining gloves]], or [[expert mining gloves]] makes the rock not deplete upon mining iron, allowing players to mine one, two, or three additional ore, respectively, before depleting.

The rocks in [[the Node mine]] provide iron ore, but no experience past level 3 Mining. As the rocks require level 15 to mine, it is impossible under standard conditions to receive experience.

==Power-mining Locations==
There are currently 21 locations that have three iron rocks in a triangle formation.

* [[Cam Torum mine]]
* [[Custodia Mountains mine]]
* [[Deepfin Mine]] - Two locations: one near the entrance and another near a [[Bank chest (amenity)]]

* [[Lovakengj mine]]
* [[Mining Guild]] - This is the preferred area to power-mine due to the iron rocks having a decreased respawn time. This mine has one spot with three iron rocks close together in the free-to-play area and one in the members area with a bank.

==Banking==
Iron ore rocks that are close to a [[bank]] include:
*[[East Varrock Mine]] - Bank at [[East Varrock Bank]].
*[[Rimmington mine|Rimmington Mine]] - Bank at the [[Port Sarim]] [[Bank Deposit Box|deposit box]] a short distance East
*[[Dorgesh-Kaan Mine]] - Bank at the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]], which requires doing the first subquest of [[Recipe for Disaster]], and [[The Lost Tribe]] is required to gain access to the mine. Also, a [[light source]], such as a [[Mining helmet]], is needed. For best results, do the following:
::#Talk to [[Kazgar]] and have him take you to the mines.
::#Mine until your inventory is full of ore.
::#Go to [[Mistag]] and have him show you out of the mines.
::#Go into the [[Lumbridge Castle]] basement through the hole and bank at the Culinaromancer's Chest if Recipe for Disaster is partially completed, or bank at the Lumbridge Castle bank on the top floor if not.
::#Deposit all the ore and then go back to the mines and repeat.
*Iron ore rocks at the [[Fight Arena Mine]] near [[Port Khazard]] - Bank at the Port Khazard deposit box or at [[Yanille]].
*The [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]] [[Piscatoris Mine|Mine]] - Bank inside the colony and must have completed [[Swan Song]]. 
*The [[Legends' Guild mine]] between [[East Ardougne]] and the [[Legends' Guild]] - Bank at [[Ardougne South Bank]]. Beware of aggressive [[grizzly bear]]s. 
*Right outside of the [[Mining Guild]] in [[Dwarven Mine]] - Bank at [[East Falador Bank]] or Bank chest at [[Motherlode Mine|Motherlode Mine.]]
*The iron ore rocks south of [[East Ardougne]] at [[South Ardougne Mine]] - Bank at Ardougne South Bank, or use an [[Ardougne cloak]] and [[Amulet of glory]] to get to the mine and bank at [[Edgeville]].
*The [[West Falador Mine]] - Bank at [[West Falador Bank]]. Also, level 5 [[Agility]] is needed to negotiate the [[shortcut]].
*For the daring and adventurous, the [[Steel Mine]] in the level 6 [[Wilderness]] north of [[Edgeville]] also offers a few iron ore rocks.
*The [[Mining Guild]] Members Area - Inside the [[Mining Guild]] there are two spots that have three iron rocks close together. - Bank in the [[Mining Guild]] Members Area

==Equipment==
*{{plink|Varrock armour 1}}, 2, 3, and 4 give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Mining gloves}} allow one additional ore to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Superior mining gloves}} allow two additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Expert mining gloves}} allow three additional ores to be mined before the rocks deplete.
*{{plink|Celestial ring}}s and [[Celestial signet|signets]] provide an invisible +4 boost to Mining level, regardless of charges. When charged with [[stardust]], they also give a 10% chance to receive an extra ore.
*{{plink|Prospector kit|pic=Prospector helmet}} boosts Mining experience by 2.5%.
*{{plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} increases the chance of obtaining gems when charged.
*{{plink|Mining cape}}s give a 5% chance to receive an extra ore.
*Varrock armour, celestial rings, and Mining capes roll independently; multiple bonus resources can be given.

The '''South-west Varrock mine''' (also called '''West Varrock Mine''') is a low-medium level [[mine]] located outside the south-western corner of [[Varrock]]. The mine contains 8 [[tin rocks]], 3 [[iron rocks]], 3 [[silver rocks]], and 3 [[clay rocks]], along with some other rocks that have no ores.

Due to its close proximity to [[Varrock west bank]] and the [[Grand Exchange]], this mine is suitable for mining large amounts of [[Iron ore|iron]], [[clay]] or other [[ores]]. However, as this is one of the few [[silver ore|silver]] mining sites on [[free-to-play]], it is often crowded with higher-level miners.

An aggressive level-6 [[mugger]] hangs around the mine and will attack players who are 12 [[Combat]] and under. Thus, 13 Combat or more is recommended in order for the mugger to be [[Tolerance|tolerant]].

Logs.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Redirect|Log}} {{Infobox Item |name = Logs |image = [[File:Logs.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = A number of wooden logs. |value = 4 |weight = 2.000 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 1511 }} [[File:Logs detail.png|left|130px]] '''Logs''', also called '''normal logs''', are obtained from [[woodcutting|cutting]] [[Regular tree|regular]], [[evergreen tree|evergreen]], [[Jungle tree|jungle]], [[Dying tree|dying]] and [[dead tree]]s, and uncommonly from [[infected root]]s. Players can burn these logs using the [[Firemaking]] [[skill]]. Cutting the logs gives 25 [[Woodcutting]] [[experience]], and burning them gives 40 Firemaking experience. These logs have no requirement to be cut or burnt. [[Members]] training [[Construction]] can bring logs to a [[sawmill]] to make [[planks]] at a cost of 100 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the [[Lunar spell]] [[Plank Make]] can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of [[runes]]. While wearing [[Kandarin headgear 1]] or higher, normal trees anywhere give double logs when chopped down but no additional experience is provided. It is currently the only log which can be coloured with [[gnomish firelighters]], which are obtained as rewards from [[Treasure Trails]]. These firelighters produce fire in one of five predetermined colours: red, blue, green, purple, or white. Coloured logs also give 50 Firemaking experience, slightly more than lighting the logs normally. {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" |Firelighters ! colspan="2" |Logs |- |{{plinkt|White firelighter}} |{{plinkt|White logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Red firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Red logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Purple firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Purple logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Green firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Green logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Blue firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Blue logs}} |} [[Members]] can also [[fletching|fletch]] these logs into [[bow]]s and [[arrow shaft]]s, and are the only type of log that can be made into [[javelin shaft]]s. Normal logs are also used to travel to [[Entrana]] or [[Taverley]] using the [[Balloon Transport System]] during and after the [[Enlightened Journey]] quest. ==Skill info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Tree |level = 1 |xp = 25 |tree = [[Tree]] |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 35.4 - 58.8 seconds }} {{Firemaking info |craftxp = 10 |bowlevel = 21 |pyrelevel = 11 |version1 = Tinderbox |version2 = Bow |version3 = Barbarian pyre |version4 = Bonfire |skill2name = Crafting |name = Logs |skill1lvl1 = 1 |skill1lvl2 = 21 |skill1lvl3 = 11 |skill2lvl3 = 1 |skill1lvl4 = 1 |skill1exp1 = 40 |skill1exp2 = 40 |skill1exp3 = 40 |skill1exp4 = 40 |facility1 = N/A |facility2 = N/A |facility3 = [[Funeral pyre (Barbarian)|Barbarian funeral pyre]] |facility4 = [[Fire]] or [[Forester's Campfire]] |tool1 = [[Tinderbox]] |tool2 = [[Bow]] |tool3 = [[Tinderbox]] or [[bow]], and an [[axe]] |tool4 = N/A |type = logs }} ==Uses== ===Firemaking=== {{Main|Firemaking}} A player only needs level 1 [[Firemaking]] and a [[tinderbox]] to turn a normal tree's [[logs]] into a [[fire]], granting 40 [[experience]]. The [[infernal axe]] provides a 1/3 chance of burning any log received when cutting trees. The player gains 20 Firemaking experience when cutting trees, half the experience gained from burning the log normally. If the Kandarin headgear 1 or above is worn in conjunction with the infernal axe, only one log is burned when a tree section is cut. ===Construction=== {{Main|Construction}} Logs may be turned into [[plank]]s at a [[Sawmill]] for use in [[Construction]] for 100 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert the logs to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes. ===Fletching=== {{Main|Fletching}} Logs from normal trees can be
